series.name: KMC-GN Series
series.architecture: Gantry construction with FIXED table and TRAVELING crossbeam — the portal moves over the workpiece along X. Note for 3D: exploded-view and scroll choreography differ from table-moving machines.

source.note: All values transcribed from the printed catalogue. Nothing in this file is AI-estimated.

atc_v_h.capacity_note: Distance between columns of 3.3 meters is not suitable for 40 tools
atc_v_h.drive: Hydraulic index motor; tool-changing arm rotated by hydraulic swing motor

specs_series.aac: Standard 2-position AAC (Automatic Attachment head Changer); optional 3–4 position

series.model_code_rule: Leading digit(s) = X travel (4→4500, 6→6500, 8→8500, 10→10500, 12→12500, 14→14500 mm); last two digits = distance between columns (33→3300, 39→3900, 45→4500 mm), which fixes Y travel (2500/3100/3700) and table width (2400/3000/3600).

features.title: Fixed Table, Traveling Crossbeam
features.copy: Gantry type construction with fixed table and traveling crossbeam — high rigidity, most suitable for ultra-long and oversized workpieces with extremely stable machining accuracy. 25% floor-space saving compared to a conventional machining center.

features.title: Extra-Large Three-Axis Travel
features.copy: X-axis 4.5–14.5 metres, Y-axis 2.5/3.1/3.7 metres, Z-axis 1.2 metres. Maximum load capacity of the fixed table up to 3000 kg/m².

features.title: X & Y Rack-and-Pinion Drive
features.copy: Torsional rigidity up to 504 Nm/arc min and radial rigidity up to 675 N/µm. Backlash eliminated through mechanical preload: two reducers with preloaded helical gears engage the rack, with a middle pinion absorbing rebound — nearly backlash-free.

features.title: Steel-Inserted Box Ways
features.copy: Steel-inserted box way and link-chain type roller bearings on all three axes.

features.title: Linear Scales on X & Y
features.copy: Positioning accuracy ±0.01/4000 mm, maintaining the highest precision during long-term operations.

features.title: X & Y-Axis Step Design
features.copy: Step difference between upper and lower box ways: 120 mm on Y-axis, 70 mm on the X (U) axis.

features.title: Stable Column Structure
features.copy: Specially designed separated column structure combats structural deformation; columns reinforced with stiff interior ribs resist bending and torsional stress. Validated with Finite Element Analysis.

features.title: Dual-Speed Gear-Drive Spindle Head
features.copy: Thermally symmetrical in-line design with spindle and motor on the head centerline; coolant flows straight through motor, reducer and spindle. 26 kW (35HP) motor, 6000 rpm, max torque 670 Nm — heavy cutting down to 375 rpm. Vertical and horizontal machining via automatic indexing head.

features.title: Automatic Attachment Changer
features.copy: Standard 2-position AAC compartment; optional 3-to-4-position AAC. Head attachments exchange automatically for multi-face machining.
